method: Sequential /ai/chat calls through the normal routing (no depth override). Records HTTP success, empty answers, client timeouts, the bridge's own recovery flags (finalAnswerRetryUsed, fastFinalPathUsed, fallbackUsed) and latency per call. PASS = HTTP 200 with a non-empty answer; FAIL otherwise. Prompts mix deterministic-core questions (greeting, arithmetic) with short maritime questions so both the instant and model tiers are exercised.
